title: Azure Landing Zones (CAF / WAF)
headline: Azure landing zones establish a governed foundation for workloads.
rules: Design management groups, identity, network and policy together.
Apply guardrails consistently and review exceptions.
Map controls to actual risks, ownership and evidence.
Review policy exceptions and compliance evidence regularly.
failures: Missing network routes or DNS can prevent workload connectivity.
Control mappings without operational evidence can hide gaps.

flashcards.question: What is a landing zone?
flashcards.answer: A governed Azure environment prepared for workloads.

flashcards.question: Why map a control to evidence?
flashcards.answer: To demonstrate and verify its operation.
